in_arabic.name: Farya
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farya هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'far' (to be free, to release), Farya evokes the sense of liberation and freedom from constraints. This evocative name is cherished in Islamic cultures for its spiritual resonance and symbolic significance.
